value.rationale: The nine blocks are intrinsically motivated by the published pairwise tangency and freeness theorem; determining which *entire free configurations* admit equations over Q is a natural arithmetic descent question. The result exhausts the nine embedded configurations, produces three previously unspecified rational free degree-nine equations, proves their sextic factors are Q-irreducible despite geometric 3-conic splitting, and determines every component field and full S3 permutation profile. The specific invariant is neither an arbitrary slice nor just a check that one coefficient is nonzero. The mathematics is a precise arithmetic classification, not a claim of a new freeness theorem.
